title: Planning coordination for Loyang and Changi North industrial estates and Changi aviation
asked: Ms Valerie Lee asked whether the Government coordinates planning across industrial activities and development in the Loyang and Changi North Industrial estates and the Changi aviation sector to minimise congestion, disamenities to nearby residents and environmental impact, and if so, what the scope and timeline of such coordination are.
response: The Government coordinates planning efforts across all land uses to minimise disamenities and environmental impact. JTC works with LTA on Transport Impact Assessments for major industrial developments, and JTC has no plans to develop new industrial estates in Loyang and Changi North in the near term. The Minister pointed to the Ministry of Transport's reply to oral Question No 35 at the 3 March 2026 Sitting on mitigating congestion in the area. In reply to a supplementary, she said the Government will look holistically at impacts on businesses, industrial land users and nearby residents.
